title: Identification of candidate markers for the isolation of neuron-specific extracellular vesicles
title_zh: 识别用于分离神经元特异性细胞外囊泡的候选标记物
abstract: Abstract Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are present in biofluids and may be useful biomarkers to non-invasively monitor brain cells, but isolating cell type-specific EVs remains challenging. Here we introduce an approach to immuno-isolate EVs from neurons and glia based on protein surface markers. We first selected transmembrane proteins suitable as cell type-specific EV markers based on gene expression and EV proteomic data. We developed a high-purity EV isolation method and cataloged the proteins present on EVs in human cerebrospinal fluid and plasma. We then computationally identified cell type-specific candidate markers for isolating EVs from neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes and microglia. Using ultrasensitive immunoassays against several predicted neuron-specific proteins, we confirmed one marker, NRXN3, as present on EVs in cerebrospinal fluid and plasma. Finally, we developed efficient EV immuno-isolation methods and applied them to isolate NRXN3 + EVs. Our work provides a general methodology for the isolation of cell type-specific EVs, advancing the goal of using EVs to study brain diseases.
abstract_zh: 摘要 细胞外囊泡（EVs）存在于生物体液中，可作为非侵入性监测脑细胞的生物标志物，但分离细胞类型特异性的EVs仍具挑战性。本文提出一种基于蛋白质表面标记的免疫分离神经元和星形胶质细胞EVs的方法。我们首先根据基因表达和EV蛋白组学数据挑选适合作为细胞类型特异性EV标记的跨膜蛋白。随后开发了高纯度EV分离方法，并对人脑脊液和血浆中EV表面蛋白进行目录化。随后通过计算方法识别出可用于分离神经元、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质细胞和小胶质细胞EVs的细胞类型特异性候选标记物。利用对多种预测的神经元特异性蛋白的超灵敏免疫测定，确认NRXN3为脑脊液和血浆中EV表面存在的标记物。最后，开发了高效的EV免疫分离方法，并将其应用于分离NRXN3+ EVs。我们的工作提供了一种通用的细胞类型特异性EV分离方法，推动了利用EVs研究脑疾病的目标。
